steps.title: Batch compression starts with your document
steps.subtitle: Scan images, choose a preset and size, then apply to the selected files.
notes: Choose your settings
Balanced is the default preset. Keep the original dimensions or scale down while preserving the aspect ratio.
Review attachment size
The total includes all local attachments in this document. Each path counts once, regardless of filters or selection.
Select, then apply
Only selected static JPEG, PNG and WebP images are processed. Results with no size savings are skipped.

steps.title: Give each image its own settings
steps.subtitle: Use different quality and size settings within a single batch.
notes: Adjust this image
Keep the original format and set quality, scale or a pixel limit. PNG uses lossless optimisation. This example scales the cover to 50%.
Save an override
This image keeps its own settings. Images without an override continue to inherit the global settings.
Check the output size
Review original and expected dimensions. Images are never enlarged. Restore inheritance from the main list.

steps.title: Compare the preview before applying
steps.subtitle: Preview in a separate dialog. Viewing the original does not start compression.
notes: Generate on demand
Click Generate compression preview to run compression. After changing settings, generate a new preview.
Compare size and quality
View the original and compressed image together. Check dimensions, file sizes and the actual file reduction.
Apply from the main panel
Previewing never writes images. Apply from the main panel to back up and overwrite each image in place, without scanning or rewriting references.

steps.title: Use a batch prefix or individual names
steps.subtitle: Enter only the name. The SiYuan ID and original extension are retained.
notes: Set a batch prefix
The default prefix is image. This example uses project for images without an individual name.
Name individual images
Enter a name such as cover in a row. It overrides the batch prefix and stays unchanged when the prefix changes.
Review the full filename
The final filename appears below the input. Clear an individual name or choose Use batch prefix to inherit.

steps.title: Save settings for quick compression
steps.subtitle: Save your usual settings, then choose Quick compress from an image context menu.
notes: Open settings directly
Open Quick compression settings from an image context menu or the main panel. No attachment scan is needed.
Save your preferences
Quick settings are saved independently of the batch panel. This example uses Balanced, original format and 75% scale.
Choose a useful size
Scaling preserves the aspect ratio. Once saved, Quick compress runs directly and records the job in task history.

steps.title: Review tasks, restore or clean up
steps.subtitle: Verify and restore originals, or remove backups and history when recovery is no longer needed.
notes: Review each result
Task history lists source and target paths, with completed, skipped or failed states for each image.
Restore original image files
Recovery verifies the image and backup hashes. Later image edits block recovery to preserve newer content.
Delete backups and history
When recovery is no longer needed, delete one task or clear all history and backups after confirmation. Current images are retained.
